name: com.elopros.sdk
description: Elo Pros for Unity: who is playing, a sign-in your server can check, signatures, names and faces, copies, items and leaderboards, with no key in the game. Desktop builds and the editor talk to the Elo launcher; WebGL builds talk to the player's wallet through elo-3.js. With no launcher and no wallet, the game plays anonymously.

samples.description: Start Elo, draw the player's name, sign in to your server, and check their copy.
